## Summary

- merged Dependabot PRs #179, #180, #181, and #182 first, with their fixes and green CI
- updated every active Cargo and npm dependency to the latest stable release, including jsonwebtoken 11, React 19.2.8, Vite 8.2.1, and the complete transitive lockfiles
- raised MSRV to Rust 1.88, aligned every CI job on current Rust 1.97.1, and upgraded the builder/runtime to digest-pinned Debian 13 images
- verified every GitHub Action SHA, Docker digest, and pinned Cargo CI tool against its current upstream release
- upgraded pre-commit-hooks to v6, made the full hook suite green, and kept archived case-study/evidence fixtures unchanged
- added grouped weekly Dependabot coverage for the UI npm manifest
- rebuilt the embedded admin UI and advanced the coverage ratchet from 78.14% to 78.18%

No active dependency surface is deferred. Historical snapshots under dev/log and docs/case-studies remain immutable reference data rather than executable manifests.

## Verification

- cargo upgrade dry run: all 39 direct packages latest
- npm outdated: empty result
- cargo check on the declared Rust 1.88 MSRV
- full pre-commit run across all tracked files
- cargo fmt, Clippy with warnings denied, full all-feature test suite, docs, release automation tests, and file-size check
- instrumented coverage suite: 18,288 / 23,392 lines, 78.18%, ratchet pass
- cargo-audit and npm audit: zero known vulnerabilities
- clean npm ci and Vite 8 production build
- full router image build and smoke test on Rust 1.97.1 / Debian 13
- tunnel image build and safe echo-transport smoke test on Alpine 3.24

## References reviewed

- Cargo dependency and lockfile guidance: https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/commands/cargo-update.html
- Cargo MSRV guidance: https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/rust-version.html
- GitHub Dependabot ecosystem configuration: https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/concepts/supply-chain-security/about-the-dependabot-yml-file
- TensorZero dependency automation: https://github.com/tensorzero/tensorzero/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml
- Helicone Rust AI gateway dependency layout: https://github.com/Helicone/ai-gateway/blob/main/Cargo.toml
- Rust 1.97.1 release: https://blog.rust-lang.org/2026/07/16/Rust-1.97.1/
- Debian official image tags: https://hub.docker.com/_/debian
